scientific_settings.interpretation_or_limit: Plot scales, not input scales or fitting scales.
No numerical template coefficients are given for the final fit. Values and source basis/moment conventions must be recovered without adopting app library numbers.
No numerical min/max or Gaussian mu/sigma for template coefficients are tabulated. Model calibration priors cannot be instantiated.

Paper names 96 rows but no application XLSX IDs/paths/checksums. HERA subenergy mappings and duplicate STAR jet rows are not fully resolved. Corrected h-minus SIDIS uncertainties and BaBar covariance must match.
No positivity constraint prescription, evaluation domain, penalty strength or per-object policy is stated. Absence of discussion is not evidence positivity is disabled.
Data resampling is named but sample count, random seeds, uncorrelated/correlated fluctuations, failed-fit handling and final ensemble selection are absent.
Qualitative stages and posterior-to-prior transfer are described, but stage ordering/details, transfer mechanics and whether Gaussian sampling remains in final starts are not fully stated.

Fitted entries/shared groups and eight unpenalized cases are identified, but numerical deltaN experimental priors, starts, bounds and all coding conventions are absent. Printed posterior uncertainties cannot replace deltaN.

Quark two-shape statement and 60-per-species count are known; gluon two shapes is count-derived. Exact implementation basis, shape summation, heavy-flavor boundary details and coefficient links need confirmation.
No per-process scale prescriptions beyond Wcharm/SIDIS, MCFM version/grids, full electroweak/CKM inputs, nuclear/off-shell model, exact TMC/HT switches or heavy-matching details are fixed.
The three numerical z windows are explicit, but no numeric energy threshold or executable row assignment, xp/p/xi conversion and bin integration conventions are supplied.
No named final minimizer, tolerances, evaluation caps, convergence test, integration accuracy or profiling solver is provided.
95% inverse-CDF intervals and mean central values are stated; tail allocation, quantile algorithm and ensemble weights are not fixed.

Repeated strange-asymmetry variable in p12 prose, second ATLAS charge in Table X, DELPHI(uds) p/xp-like variable in Table XIV, PDF versus HTML dates, and Rs upper uncertainty +.22 versus +.23 need explicit resolution.

publication_ambiguities.detail: The strange-release sentence compares delta_sbar to itself. Keep the literal source problem; Eq7-8 support independent s/sbar modeling but do not establish an exact executable release schedule.
Second ATLAS observable prints W-minus+cbar; Eq1 discussion and Fig3 indicate the other physical charge W-plus+cbar. Row observable retained as printed; do not silently correct.
DELPHI(uds) prints differential p while neighboring rows print z_p. Observable retained; conversion requires confirmation.
Rs(x=.1) upper uncertainty is +.23 in abstract and p27 but +.22 in conclusion. These are validation-output numbers, not campaign settings.
arXiv v3 history is 15 Oct 2025; downloaded PDF title date 17 Oct 2025; live experimental HTML date 24 Aug 2026. Version and content checksum pinned; do not use HTML date as publication history.

unresolved_settings.title: Exact numerical parameter starts and fitted model coefficient tables
unresolved_settings.what_is_missing: No numerical template coefficients are given for the final fit. Values and source basis/moment conventions must be recovered without adopting app library numbers.
unresolved_settings.why_it_matters_to_FEMTOMIND: Required to construct a concrete campaign and faithfully reproduce calibration.
unresolved_settings.future_verification_source: Original final JAM24 input/parameter snapshots and author validation.

unresolved_settings.title: Bounds and Gaussian hyperparameters
unresolved_settings.what_is_missing: No numerical min/max or Gaussian mu/sigma for template coefficients are tabulated. Model calibration priors cannot be instantiated.

unresolved_settings.future_verification_source: Author calibration configurations and stage logs.

unresolved_settings.title: Dataset file IDs, exact releases and point/covariance arrays
unresolved_settings.what_is_missing: Paper names 96 rows but no application XLSX IDs/paths/checksums. HERA subenergy mappings and duplicate STAR jet rows are not fully resolved. Corrected h-minus SIDIS uncertainties and BaBar covariance must match.

unresolved_settings.future_verification_source: Author data manifest/covariances and experimental tables, in a later approved stage.

unresolved_settings.title: Positivity policy and algorithm
unresolved_settings.what_is_missing: No positivity constraint prescription, evaluation domain, penalty strength or per-object policy is stated. Absence of discussion is not evidence positivity is disabled.
unresolved_settings.why_it_matters_to_FEMTOMIND: App forces all four positivity flags True; this cannot be declared paper matched.
unresolved_settings.future_verification_source: Original final input and native implementation, only after separate permission.

unresolved_settings.title: Final MC replica count and resampling construction
unresolved_settings.what_is_missing: Data resampling is named but sample count, random seeds, uncorrelated/correlated fluctuations, failed-fit handling and final ensemble selection are absent.
unresolved_settings.why_it_matters_to_FEMTOMIND: App needs replica count, bootstrap and initialization choices; errors depend on the sampling design.
unresolved_settings.future_verification_source: Author ensemble manifest, sampling driver and final run logs.

unresolved_settings.title: Calibration transfer and final starting ensemble
unresolved_settings.what_is_missing: Qualitative stages and posterior-to-prior transfer are described, but stage ordering/details, transfer mechanics and whether Gaussian sampling remains in final starts are not fully stated.
unresolved_settings.why_it_matters_to_FEMTOMIND: A single library/default or uniform-random start is not a validated reconstruction of the multistep method.
unresolved_settings.future_verification_source: Original staged driver, stage configurations and calibrated parameter samples.

unresolved_settings.title: Full 43-normalization input configuration
unresolved_settings.what_is_missing: Fitted entries/shared groups and eight unpenalized cases are identified, but numerical deltaN experimental priors, starts, bounds and all coding conventions are absent. Printed posterior uncertainties cannot replace deltaN.
unresolved_settings.why_it_matters_to_FEMTOMIND: App has canonical SIA norm definitions and no normalizer-penalty control; mismatch could change objective.
unresolved_settings.future_verification_source: Original normalization configuration and quoted experimental systematic sources.

unresolved_settings.title: Precise FF two-shape implementation and links
unresolved_settings.what_is_missing: Quark two-shape statement and 60-per-species count are known; gluon two shapes is count-derived. Exact implementation basis, shape summation, heavy-flavor boundary details and coefficient links need confirmation.
unresolved_settings.why_it_matters_to_FEMTOMIND: App has optional shapes and default ties that do not automatically reproduce all functional equalities.
unresolved_settings.future_verification_source: Author model specification and final FF parameter map.

unresolved_settings.title: Remaining perturbative and nuclear/power-correction choices
unresolved_settings.what_is_missing: No per-process scale prescriptions beyond Wcharm/SIDIS, MCFM version/grids, full electroweak/CKM inputs, nuclear/off-shell model, exact TMC/HT switches or heavy-matching details are fixed.
unresolved_settings.why_it_matters_to_FEMTOMIND: Most are inherited rather than exposed in current composer.
unresolved_settings.future_verification_source: Original theoretical configuration and grids; cited primary experimental/theory references if authorized.

unresolved_settings.title: SIA high/low-energy classification and variable conversions
unresolved_settings.what_is_missing: The three numerical z windows are explicit, but no numeric energy threshold or executable row assignment, xp/p/xi conversion and bin integration conventions are supplied.
unresolved_settings.why_it_matters_to_FEMTOMIND: SIA cuts are canonical in app and cannot be freely overwritten by a paper catalog.
unresolved_settings.future_verification_source: Author SIA data map/readers and cited experimental definitions.

unresolved_settings.title: Optimizer, convergence and numerical settings
unresolved_settings.what_is_missing: No named final minimizer, tolerances, evaluation caps, convergence test, integration accuracy or profiling solver is provided.
unresolved_settings.why_it_matters_to_FEMTOMIND: App uses SciPy trf/dogbox and max_nfev; successful execution is not a converged reproduction.

unresolved_settings.title: Exact credible-interval convention
unresolved_settings.what_is_missing: 95% inverse-CDF intervals and mean central values are stated; tail allocation, quantile algorithm and ensemble weights are not fixed.
unresolved_settings.why_it_matters_to_FEMTOMIND: App uses equal-tailed pointwise intervals; exact paper correspondence is unverified.

unresolved_settings.what_is_missing: Repeated strange-asymmetry variable in p12 prose, second ATLAS charge in Table X, DELPHI(uds) p/xp-like variable in Table XIV, PDF versus HTML dates, and Rs upper uncertainty +.22 versus +.23 need explicit resolution.

findings.finding: For a free model parameter with truthy lowercase gaussian, gen_flat reads mean and std directly and draws np.random.normal(loc=mean, scale=std), rejecting until within its min/max inclusive. Missing mean/std raises KeyError. FitPack sampler itself does not validate finiteness or positive standard deviation; invalid/degenerate configurations can error or fail to terminate.

Gaussian initialization applies only j==1 free distribution parameters (fixed is False). Fixed or linked parameters are absent from the free sampling vector. Dataset normalization parameters use j==2 and remain uniformly sampled within bounds, even if Gaussian metadata were attached.

Metadata alone is insufficient: MAXLIKE.get_guess calls gen_flat only when conf['flat par'] is true. With false, it uses input starting values. A supplied seed initializes NumPy before draws. Previous-step or buffer values may overwrite generated guesses afterward.

Lowercase gaussian metadata controls initialization and does not append a Gaussian parameter-prior penalty in the inspected current objective path. MAXLIKE.get_residuals combines RESMAN experimental/constraint residuals with correlated and normalization residuals; neither inspected component consumes gaussian/mean/std for parameter penalties. Existing experimental nuisance and positivity penalties remain distinct.

FF library returns deep-copied raw metadata; FF resolver preserves/accepts lowercase gaussian, mean, std along with value/min/max/fixed. It requires finite mean/std, std>0, and boolean gaussian. Uppercase Gaussian is outside the accepted field whitelist and is not preserved as an override. Gateway FF normalization and campaign snapshot carry the resolved lowercase metadata into materialized input.

Non-FF PDF/pion gateway normalization reconstructs rows with name/fixed/value/min/max only, and common materializer non-FF overrides carry only value/min/max/fixed. Adding new Gaussian metadata through that card pathway is not supported. Existing unmodified template fields may survive template composition, but template metadata was not inspected and must not be assumed.

The frontend editor merges library rows and edits; FF metadata survives ordinary edits, but visible controls cover enabled/fixed/links/value/min/max, not Gaussian prior settings.
